title: The Puppet Show
text: A puppet theatre stands on a cart, curtains open and no puppeteer in sight, playing to an audience of silent crows. The little wooden figures fight and bleed red paint. Every one of them looks like you, down to the scars.

options.label: Watch the show to its end to learn how your story goes.

outcomes.text: Against all odds it ends happily. It is a comfort, and you do not ask why.
It ends as such shows do, with every little wooden you lying still while the crows applaud.

options.label: The sharpest looks for the strings, to find whoever works them.

outcomes.text: There are none, and then there are. They lead off into the trees to something hidden.

options.label: Burn the cart before the show can finish.

outcomes.text: The puppets scream in your voices as they burn.
